author: iroksmes
body: Hello, I am Iroksmes, I do agree that I was spawn trolling my own team. However, I freed them after a minute or so. I also believe the ban to be harsh and unfair since I was banned for this incident two game after it happened. Please allow me to return to my favorite server, and I do apologize for my actions as well. Have a great day, Iroksmes

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Considering this temp-ban is valid I will not be appealing it. We appreciate you owning up to your mistakes however the moderator did the right thing in issuing the punishment. You will be able to play again within the next day or so.

Regards,
Mango_
